key_insight: VeriCUA verifies computer-agent task completion by actively gathering missing evidence rather than judging only fixed observations or accessible application state.
engineering_relevance: A shared verification procedure spans desktop, mobile, and web environments, potentially reducing platform-specific verifier engineering.
method: Inspect available context and construct a task-completion rubric.
Select GUI or code checks to investigate unresolved requirements.
Combine findings under explicit evidence rules in online and offline settings.
evidence_signal: Experiments report better agreement with reference labels than compared baselines, with the largest offline gains on hard cases and stronger rejection of false completion claims online.
watch_item: Deployment should assess exploration cost and evidence-access constraints; the abstract does not quantify these trade-offs.
paper_title: VeriCUA: Verification as Agentic Exploration for Computer-Using Agents
